request.subject: UNIT:GUARD

layers.text: Make him a heavily armoured shield-bearer in full polished steel plate: big round pauldrons, breastplate, gauntlets and leg plates. The shield becomes a much bigger tall wide tower shield covering his body from chin to feet, crimson with a bold gold cross and a thick riveted steel border, planted in front of him; feet wide apart. Keep the face, the kettle helmet with its gold band, the upright spear, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
